runVcenterCheck.name: PowerShell
runVcenterCheck.Description: Executes a Powershell script on a remote device
runVcenterCheck.ScriptCode:
$user = '%vCenterUser%' #Create Global Variable
$pass = '%vCenterPass%' #Create Global Variable
$hostIP = '%currVcenterName%' #vCenter Name
$vcLocation = '%currVcenterLocation%' #vCenter Location Name
$Permission = Set-PowerCLIConfiguration -InvalidCertificateAction Ignore -Confirm:$false




#Populate PSObject with the required vm properties
function vmProperties
{
param([PSObject]$view)

$list=foreach ($vm in $view){

#Get net info
$ips=$vm.guest.net.ipaddress

#State info
if ($vm.Runtime.PowerState -eq "poweredOn") {$state="ON"}
elseif ($vm.Runtime.PowerState -eq "poweredOff") {$state="OFF"}
else {$state="n/a"}


#Populate object
[PSCustomObject]@{
"Name" = $vm.Name
"OSType" = $vm.Guest.GuestFullName
"Hostname" = $vm.summary.guest.hostname
"InstanceUUID" = $vm.Summary.config.instanceUuid
"IP" = $ips
"VM_State" = $state
"UUID" = $vm.Summary.config.Uuid
"VM_ID" = $vm.Summary.vm.value
}
}

return $list
}




#Path to CSV report
$repPath= "%repPathPrefix%%currVcenterLocation%.csv"



Try{
#Drop any previously established connections
Disconnect-VIServer -Confirm:$False -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

#Connect to vCenter or ESXi
if (($user -eq "") -or ($pass -eq ""))
{Connect-VIServer $hostIP -ErrorAction Stop}
else
{$Conn = Connect-VIServer $hostIP -User $user -Password $pass -Force -ErrorAction Stop}



#Get a VirtualMachine view of all vms
$vmView = Get-View -viewtype VirtualMachine

#Iterate through the view object, write the set of vm properties to a PSObject and convert to CSV File
(vmProperties -view $vmView) | Export-CSV -LiteralPath $repPath -NoTypeInformation -ErrorAction Stop -Append

#Disconnect from vCenter or ESXi
Disconnect-VIServer -Confirm:$False -Server $hostIP -ErrorAction Stop

#Load report in default browser
#Invoke-Expression "cmd.exe /C start $repPath"

return "SUCCESS - " + $vcLocation + " - " + $hostIP 
}
Catch
{
return "ERROR - "  + $vcLocation +  " - " + $hostIP + " - " + $_.Exception.Message
}
runVcenterCheck.label: Powershell
runVcenterCheck.description: Executes a Powershell script on a remote device
